title: Color Spans
theme: revelation_dark.css
version: 0.2.7
newSlideOnHeading: false
---

A [red word]{.red}, a [green one]{.green}, [blue]{.blue} and [purple]{.purple}.

[Gold]{.gold}, [yellow]{.yellow}, [orange]{.orange} and [highlight]{.highlight} share a style.

[Grey]{.grey}, [gray]{.gray}, [silver]{.silver} and [muted]{.muted} share another.

Nested: [**bold red**]{.red} and __[underlined blue]{.blue}__.

Unknown stays literal: [text]{.chartreuse}

Inline code is untouched: `[text]{.red}`

A [link](https://example.com){.red} is not a span.

```
[in a fence]{.red}
```
